summary: The final account says node 3's log ends in a StopSign while leader 4 lacks the marker and has moved past that position, but the existing zero-divergence figure cannot confirm or refute that because the harness keeps only Decided(Value) entries and compares the shorter prefix. This revision adds a direct read of the entry kinds around the reconfiguration position: n3_k35, n3_k36, n3_k37 and n4_k35, n4_k36, n4_k37, each produced by the existing entry_status helper over read(i) for i in 35, 36 and 37, which report decided, undecided, trimmed, snapshotted, stopsign or none. Everything else is unchanged: the seeded 900-action schedule, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, 150-round convergence, node 3 ordered trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags and the converged_all comparison. The receipt will show whether the two nodes hold different kinds of entry at the same index. A stopsign on node 3 against a value on leader 4 at index 36 would turn the current progress finding into a concrete agreement divergence that the harness check missed; identical kinds would instead confirm that the split is confined to how far each log has advanced.
